assessment.label: misalignment
assessment.reason: Query shows low 1x (~0.0009-0.0014) on all 4 channels with elevated 2x on channels 0 (0.0114) and 2 (0.00906) and low 2x on 1 (0.00288) and 3 (0.00174). This matches labelled misalignment trials which show 1x <~0.0012 with 2x-dominant on ch0/ch2 (e.g., 0.0156/0.0150, 0.0149/0.0117, 0.0061/0.0048) and low 2x on ch1/ch3, unlike unbalance (1x ~0.005-0.018 dominant) and looseness (elevated 1x ~0.004-0.014 on all channels with elevated 2x/3x). Kurtosis ~3.2-3.7 and crest ~4.5-5.5 also align with misalignment/normal, not impulsive. Limitation: radial signals and one short recording may not uniquely distinguish faults; amplitude units unspecified so comparison is relative to same-rig references.
